claim: Patchline renders contributor recognition badges exclusively from gate-backed data, so a badge can never claim credit for a capability that is not proven by a real gate. Each contributor lists the capabilities they shipped; the badge worker keeps only the contributions whose gate script actually exists, computes a deterministic recognition tier from the count of gate-backed contributions, and emits shields-style badge endpoints plus a Markdown wall of fame. The gate proves that every awarded badge is backed by an existing gate and that tiers are computed deterministically from verified counts alone.
